name: hero-ai-infrastructure
blurb: Full-screen hero with animated 3D shader backdrop and staggered scroll-triggered reveals.
description: Dark hero section with ShaderGradient 3D background (WebGL), responsive nav, headline, dual CTAs, and logo wall. Uses TimelineAnimation to stagger text and button reveals on scroll.
use_when: B2B AI/infrastructure landing page with emphasis on technical prowess and scale.
avoid_when: Low-end devices; WebGL shader gradient is expensive. Requires scroll handler (TimelineAnimation depends on viewport observer).
a11y: Navigation links and buttons are focusable. Animated elements are text/images, not decorative overlay. No prefers-reduced-motion guard on stagger animations.
